_comment: Rarity roll weights for Omega Realm loot. Holds the relative weights used to roll an item's rarity tier (e.g. common/uncommon/rare/...) once a drop is decided, and any per-context (tier/biome/boss) weight overrides. The Rust omega-server is the numeric authority: rarity is rolled server-side on monster death and clients never roll ('the client requests, the server decides'); this file mirrors the weights for tooling and the server wins on disagreement. Governing GDD doc: docs/gdd/loot.md (STATUS: TBD/UNBUILT — rarity tiers + affix system are an explicit open question, no loot/rarity system in code today).
